newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise to redeem $172.5 mln pref shares.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise to redeem $172.5 mln pref shares.

text.p: Britain's Enterprise Oil Plc said on Monday it has issued redemption notices for 6.9 million preference shares with a nominal value of $172.5 million or $25 per share.

The redemption, set for August 6, is for all of its 10.5 percent Series A cumulative dollar preference shares and will enable Enterprise to achieve annual savings in finance costs of over four million stg before tax.
Enterprise said in a statement that it will pay a premium of five percent of the nominal value, or $1.25 per share, amounting to $8.6 million.
An exceptional charge of around nine million stg -- comprising the premium plus four million stg of other costs -- will be recorded in the group's results for the second half of 1997.
